column4: dialect-gated: cmd/cleat-worker/a_plugin_start_workflow_is_tenant_scoped_test.go's cleat#2187/#2204 regression tests run one function per dialect rather than one function with per-dialect subtests, so each name is its own skip rather than a subtest match. This job (./cmd/..., CLEAT_TEST_DB only) supplies PostgreSQL, so the MySQL and SQL Server functions skip and the PostgreSQL ones (plain and sharded) run. Measured: env -u CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL -u CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL CLEAT_TEST_DB=<pg> go test ./cmd/cleat-worker/ -run TestStartPluginWorkflow_ -count=1 -json | grep '"Action":"skip"' reports exactly these two.
